holdings.thesis: HOLD: Evercore upgraded to Outperform on 9/1/26 and doubled its PT to $210, citing a "Netflix-like" growth setup from survey data; DAU +23% YoY to 58.7M, paid subscribers +17%. Earnings-growth flag reflects AI-feature reinvestment, not a slowdown.

HOLD: Google Cloud revenue +82% YoY offsets AI-talent-departure and search-growth concerns behind a recent 6% pullback. DOJ is reportedly weighing a forced Chrome/Android divestiture after the search-monopoly ruling -- a known overhang already reflected in the original thesis, not a new thesis break.

TRIMMED 20%: stock fell 17% on the 7/29 Q2 print (net sales missed consensus) and multiple law firms (Pomerantz, Hagens Berman, Bronstein Gewirtz) are now investigating potential securities-fraud claims that Q1-call statements about backlog/deployment execution were misleading. Position was down 20.8% vs. cost basis, approaching stop-loss. Fundamentals still support a core position (net sales +24% YoY, Strong Buy consensus PT ~$364), but trimming to reduce single-name/litigation-headline risk while the investigations play out.
HOLD: Q2 beat the high end of guidance on both lines (revenue +20% YoY constant currency, operating margin 13.7% vs. 11.4% a year ago); AWS is expanding into Saudi Arabia with a $5.3B investment.
